name: com.gameframex.unity.network
description:
GameFrameX Network — Unity channel-based network communication package. Manages multiple named connections over TCP (Socket) or WebSocket with configurable packet pipelines (send / receive header and body handlers, heartbeat, compression / decompression), attribute-based message-id handler registration, per-channel message serializers, async RPC (Call<TResult> with lifecycle callbacks and timeout), focus-aware heartbeat, ignored send / receive log id lists, and event-driven connection status notifications. Startup moves to code-level NetworkOptions (GameFrameXOptions.Configure). Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Network — Unity 基于通道的网络通信功能包。基于 TCP（Socket）或 WebSocket 管理多个命名连接，支持可配置数据包管道（发送/接收头部与包体处理器、心跳、压缩/解压）、特性驱动的消息 ID 处理器注册、通道级消息序列化器、异步 RPC（Call<TResult> 含生命周期回调与超时）、焦点感知心跳、收发日志忽略 ID 列表，以及事件驱动的连接状态通知。启动配置收敛为代码级 NetworkOptions（GameFrameXOptions.Configure）。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
